thread:
Rina Patel: heads up — LumenCare private deploy saw ~30m of 403s from app layer after scheduled KMS rotation. Customers hit errors for secrets decrypt. :frowning:
Omar Liu: timeline? rotation job ran from control plane at 02:05 UTC?
Rina Patel: yes scheduled job kicked at 02:05, first observed errors 02:06.
sec-bot: Alert: 403 decrypt spike detected for tenant=lumencare at 2026-02-12T02:06:12Z. Audit ref: rot-20260212-02.
Oncall Ops: can someone paste the keystore-proxy log snippet?
Rina Patel: logs (sanitized):
```
2026-02-12T02:06:11Z keystore-proxy ERROR tenant=lumencare msg="decrypt denied" code=403 key=kms://lumencare/vers-20260212 principal=svcacct-lumencare
2026-02-12T02:06:11Z hsm-connector WARN  svc=shim status=403 reason="principal not in key policy"
```
Samantha Ortiz: sounds like the alias swapped to a new key version but principal bindings weren't applied. We've seen a similar race in older automation.
Omar Liu: which rotation binary version? If it's 2.0.7 the propagate flag defaulted to off.
sec-bot: Rotation metadata: automation-runner@infra invoked rotation v2.0.7, flag --propagate-principals=false, audit-entry present.
Oncall Ops: confirmed — tenant is still on infra-agent v2.0.7.
Rina Patel: mitigation plan? we don't want to rollback keys in case of audit issues.
Samantha Ortiz: quick fix: grant decrypt to svcacct-lumencare on the new key version, then validate. Long term: change default and add pre-checks.
Omar Liu: agree. Also verify network policies — although logs show 403, double-check netpol to ensure proxy could reach hsm endpoint during rotation window.
sec-bot: Netpol logs: no DENY for keystore-proxy->hsm-connector between 02:00 and 02:10 UTC. Connectivity validated.
Oncall Ops: applying manual grant now: `kmsctl grant --key vers-20260212 --principal svcacct-lumencare --actions decrypt,GenerateDataKey` -> exit 0.
Oncall Ops: re-tested app decrypts, responses returned 200 and latency normal. Customer confirmed recovered at 02:12 UTC.
Rina Patel: filing a post-incident note. Root cause: rotation job didn't propagate principals due to default flag. Remediation: manual principal grant.
Samantha Ortiz: action items: 1) patch rotation job to default propagate=true (hotfix within 48 hrs), 2) add infra-agent preflight test to assert principal list parity post-rotate, 3) add alert for >5 decrypt 403s/min per tenant, 4) document upgrade notes for private deploy customers.
Omar Liu: security follow-up: ensure keystore-proxy authenticates with short-lived mTLS certs rather than long-lived tokens to reduce blast radius. Also add policy bounding so a principal scoped to tenant keys only.
sec-bot: Reminder: attach audit artifacts (rotation job log, key create event, principal grant entry) to the incident record for customer compliance.
Rina Patel: I'll draft customer communication: apology + summary + actions + ETA (48h hotfix, 2 weeks full rollout). Any edits?
Samantha Ortiz: add note that we rotated without rolling back keys and that no data was exposed — only decrypt attempts were denied.
Oncall Ops: uploading netflow and audit logs to secure bucket with restricted access.
Rina Patel: thanks team. I'll open tasks INF-4212 (propagate-default), INF-4213 (preflight test), INF-4214 (403-alert). Scheduling a short postmortem sync in #eng-security.
